_comment: Standard (non-holiday) return windows in days from purchase, by verified merchant id. Policies change and have exceptions (final sale, activatable devices, marketplace sellers): the return checker treats these as guidance and always tells the user to confirm on the merchant's site. 'open_ended' means no fixed window for most items. Holiday extensions are not modeled.

amazon.notes: Most items; marketplace sellers mostly follow Amazon's policy.

target.notes: Target-owned brands up to a year.

bestbuy.notes: Activatable devices 14 days; restocking fees on some items.

costco.notes: Most items have no fixed window.
